It fits well on my bed and makes my sleeping setup feel more comfortable. S Sneha Kapoor Useful Dual Firmness I like being able to choose the firmness that feels right for me. The topper is easy to add to my existing bed and makes my sleep setup more versatile. M Meera Joshi Nice Mattress Upgrade The topper adds a comfortable layer to my bed, and I like that it is only two inches high. I would have preferred slightly more cushioning, but it works well overall. V Vivek Menon Worth The Addition This topper was a practical choice for improving my current mattress. The design is simple, and I appreciate the breathable fabric and secure corner straps. A Arjun Patel Helpful For Daily Sleep I bought this to change the feel of my existing mattress. The dual-firmness option is useful, although it took me some time to decide which side suited me better. 1 2
